question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

"I can't believe I recieved such a beautiful gift."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"recieved"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"received"**.

 
 
• **Meaning:** To be given or presented with something. (प्राप्त करना)
 
• **Example:** She was delighted when she **received** an award for her hard work.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gift** (उपहार): Something given to someone without expecting anything in return.

 
 
• **Example:** She received a wonderful **gift **on her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Such** (ऐसा): Used to emphasize the quality or degree of something.
 
 
• **Example:** I’ve never seen **such **a beautiful view before.
 
 
 
• **Believe** (विश्वास करना): To accept something as true or to have faith in something.
 
 
• **Example:** I can’t **believe **how amazing this gift is.
